universities.name: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology
universities.summary: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET) is a private self-financing engineering college founded in 2001 on East Coast Road, Mamallapuram, Chengalpattu district, Tamil Nadu. It is an autonomous college affiliated to Anna University, which awards its degrees. It teaches 18 B.E./B.Tech branches, M.E., M.Tech, MBA and MCA, plus four branches at a Tiruppur off-campus opened in 2026.
universities.campusLifestyle: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET)'s Mamallapuram campus covers 11.65 acres with 44,886 sq m of buildings, according to its 2026-27 AICTE application. It lists 920 student computers, 1,200 Mbps internet and a library of 56,578 volumes with a 530-seat reading room, open 8 am to 8 pm, with DELNET access. Sports facilities include a cricket ground, running track and football, volleyball, basketball and kabaddi courts, plus a gym. A dispensary with a part-time doctor runs during working hours.
universities.cityProfile: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET) is at 157 East Coast Road, Poonjeri village, Mamallapuram (PIN 603104), in Thirukazhukundram taluk of Chengalpattu district, Tamil Nadu. AICTE still records the address under Kanchipuram district. The nearest railway station listed by TNEA 2026 is Chengalpattu. The college's medical-emergency partner, Chettinad Health City, is at Kelambakkam, about 20 km away. DSCET's Tiruppur off-campus, opened in 2026-27, is on NH 47 at Chengapalli in Uthukuli taluk, Tiruppur district (PIN 638812), 18 km from the district headquarters and 6 km from Uthukuli railway station. Other Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan colleges in Coimbatore and Perambalur are separate institutions.
universities.practicalExposure: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET) is autonomous: its Academic Council sets the curriculum and its Controller of Examinations conducts exams, while Anna University awards the degrees. AICTE makes an internship mandatory for every admitted student. The training and placement cell runs aptitude, communication and soft-skills training from the first year, mock interviews, industrial visits and campus recruitment. In DSCET's NIRF 2025 data, 314 of 320 B.E./B.Tech students graduating in 2023-24 were placed at a median salary of INR 4,20,000, and 79 of 98 postgraduates at a median of INR 3,60,000. The campus has an AICTE IDEA Lab, an Institution's Innovation Council and an entrepreneurship development cell.
universities.hostelOverview: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET) has on-campus hostels for men (650 places in 176 rooms) and women (500 places in 133 rooms), according to its 2026-27 AICTE application. TNEA 2026 lists hostel room rent of INR 23,800, mess of INR 57,800 and electricity of INR 3,400 a year, about INR 85,000 a year in all, plus a caution deposit of INR 5,000. The Tiruppur off-campus lists boys' and girls' hostels at the same charges. Hostel rules set study hours from 6.00 to 7.30 pm and allow one outing a month on a holiday.
universities.dietarySupport: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET)'s hostel messes serve both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, according to TNEA 2026, at a mess charge of INR 57,800 a year. The college's hostel page describes a kitchen with steam cooking and gas stoves beside the dining halls. No menu or provision for specific regional or religious diets is published, so ask the hostel office before joining.
universities.safetyOverview: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET)'s 2026-27 AICTE application lists an anti-ragging committee and anti-ragging squads, an internal committee on sexual harassment and an SC/ST committee, and the college also has a women empowerment cell. Hostel residents need the warden's permission to stay in during working days and must log every exit and return.
universities.studentSupport: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET) has appointed student counsellors and runs an online grievance registration portal, according to its 2026-27 AICTE application. TNEA entrants may claim the First Graduate concession, the 7.5% government-school fee waiver, the AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver or the Post-Matric Scholarship. Admissions: dscetadmission@dscet.ac.in.

faq.question: Is DSCET Mamallapuram autonomous and affiliated to Anna University?
faq.answer: Yes, Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET) is an autonomous college affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, which awards its degrees. Anna University lists it in Chengalpattu district with examination code 3105, DoTE Tamil Nadu marks it autonomous in TNEA 2026, and AICTE approves it for 2026-27 as a private self-financing institution, permanent ID 1-2497331.

faq.question: What is the TNEA code for DSCET?
faq.answer: The TNEA counselling code for Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET) at Mamallapuram is 1322; its Tiruppur off-campus uses code 2323. In TNEA 2026, code 1322 offered 18 branches, including CS, IT, AD (AI and Data Science), EC, EE, ME, AE, CE, BM, AG, FD, AM, SC, CI, EF, ER, RI and MZ (Mechatronics).

faq.question: What is the NAAC grade of DSCET?
faq.answer: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET) holds a NAAC A+ grade with a CGPA of 3.29 in its second accreditation cycle, declared on 7 December 2023. NBA accreditation of six B.E./B.Tech branches and the MBA ran to 30 June 2025 or 30 June 2026, and NBA's register lists no renewal.

faq.question: What is the fee at DSCET?
faq.answer: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET) publishes no 2026-27 tuition figure; TNEA states that tuition follows Government norms set by the Tamil Nadu fee committee, so ask the college. TNEA 2026 lists hostel room rent of INR 23,800, mess of INR 57,800 and electricity of INR 3,400 a year, a one-time admission fee of INR 10,000 and transport of INR 8,500 to 39,000 a year.

faq.question: Can NRI or international students apply to DSCET?
faq.answer: Non-Resident Indians can apply to Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET) for 2026-27 AICTE-approved supernumerary NRI seats: 12 in B.E. CSE, 9 in B.Tech IT and 15 in B.Tech AI and Data Science. AICTE approves no seats for foreign nationals, PIO, OCI or Gulf quotas. TNEA is for Indian nationals and Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO card holders not born abroad after 4 March 2021.

faq.question: How do I get B.E. or B.Tech admission at DSCET?
faq.answer: Most B.E./B.Tech seats at Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET) are filled through TNEA: register at tneaonline.org, get a rank from Mathematics (100), Physics (50) and Chemistry (50), and choose code 1322 (or 2323 for Tiruppur). TNEA 2026 counselling ran 20 July to 30 August. Management-quota seats are applied for at the college.

faq.question: How do I get MBA, MCA or M.E. admission at DSCET?
faq.answer: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET) admits MBA and MCA students on TANCET scores, through Tamil Nadu's MBA/MCA single-window counselling under code 1322 or the management quota; the MBA also accepts CAT, XAT, MAT and ATMA. M.E. and M.Tech admission uses CEETA-PG or GATE scores. The 2026 TANCET tests were on 9 May and CEETA-PG on 10 May 2026.

faq.question: Is DSCET the same as Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan Engineering College, Perambalur?
faq.answer: No, Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET) at Mamallapuram is a separate college from Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan Engineering College, Perambalur, Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering, Coimbatore, and Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan University. Each has its own AICTE record and TNEA code; DSCET's AICTE permanent ID is 1-2497331 and its TNEA code is 1322.

faq.question: What is the DSCET Tiruppur campus?
faq.answer: The Tiruppur campus of Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology (DSCET) is an off-campus at Chengapalli on NH 47, Tiruppur district, opened in 2026-27. AICTE approves B.E. CSE (120 seats), B.Tech AI and Data Science (120), B.E. ECE (60) and B.Tech IT (60) there, offered in TNEA 2026 under code 2323, plus an MBA.

faq.question: Does DSCET have hostels?

TNEA 2026 lists room rent of INR 23,800, mess of INR 57,800 and electricity of INR 3,400 a year, with a caution deposit of INR 5,000.
